note: What each route's start ships: a real browser lists the files a first load fetches (scripts/budgets/list.mjs), and each counts at the bytes the hub sends for it, from the build (measure.mjs; response headers not counted). `mise run budgets`, the `budgets` job of check.yml. A change may grow a route by the allowance over its merge-base, and no route has a fixed ceiling (a ceiling a little above today's size would trip every few days, since 20 web commits grew home by +1,169 B in two days; total growth is read in the release draft against the last release). The check reads these limits from the merge-base, never from the change, so raising the allowance, or dropping a route, is its own commit, with the owner's yes: docs/context/quality.md#budgets-check. The allowance is PROPOSED until the owner confirms it: it was set from the data below, not by the owner. Allowance 500 B: the 20 newest commits that touched web/ or scripts/web-dist (11-12 to 11-13), each built and listed by the browser on its parent and itself, grew home by -40 to +356 B each (median +19 B, 90th percentile +181 B). Each route's entry is empty, or names an allowance of its own.

allowance.why: Room for an ordinary change: 20 of the last 20 web commits grew a start by 356 B or less, and too little for a script, a font or a stylesheet to slip into the start. Growth beyond it goes to the owner with an impact note.
